verdict.rationale: Helicone documents some of its own isolation mechanisms. Prompt versions can be deployed independently to production, staging and development environments [helicone-docs-45]. The Playground lets you test prompts, sessions and traces in the UI [helicone-gh-3]. A Docker Compose self-host option is offered for local development [helicone-docs-20], which could serve as an isolated instance. None of this is described as a sandbox that keeps test traffic and logged data separate from production. missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test-mode or separate workspace with isolated request data, explicit guarantees that test traffic doesn't mix with production logs, and hands-on corroboration.
